program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((paths
          (flatmap
            (lambda (color)
              (let ((cells (find-color g color)))
                (if (= (length cells) 2)
                    (let* ((a (first cells))
                           (b (second cells))
                           (r1 (fst a))
                           (c1 (snd a))
                           (r2 (fst b))
                           (c2 (snd b)))
                      (cond
                        [(= r1 r2)
                         (let ((cmin (min c1 c2))
                               (cmax (max c1 c2)))
                           (if (all?
                                 (lambda (c)
                                   (or (= (cell-at g r1 c) 0)
                                       (= c c1)
                                       (= c c2)))
                                 (range cmin (+ cmax 1)))
                               (map (lambda (c) (list r1 c color)) (range cmin (+ cmax 1)))
                               (list)))]
                        [(= c1 c2)
                         (let ((rmin (min r1 r2))
                               (rmax (max r1 r2)))
                           (if (all?
                                 (lambda (r)
                                   (or (= (cell-at g r c1) 0)
                                       (= r r1)
                                       (= r r2)))
                                 (range rmin (+ rmax 1)))
                               (map (lambda (r) (list r c1 color)) (range rmin (+ rmax 1)))
                               (list)))]
                        [else (list)]))
                    (list))))
            (grid-colors g 0))))
    (paint-cells g paths)))
